rows.grounds: locative adverb indicating placement in the center
adverb linking the preceding sprinkling and placement
object of placement in the ritual center
absolutive of ā-dhā, action completed before abandonment
compound denoting the portion associated with carnivorous fire

items.question: Should the carnivorous portion be abandoned after fire is placed in the middle?
premises: Fire is placed in the middle.
The carnivorous portion is to be abandoned.
items.inference: The ritual prescription is to abandon the carnivorous portion after placing fire in the middle.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of kravyādāṃśaṃ is not fully specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the middle, having thus placed the fire, one should abandon the carnivorous portion.
